integration_preconditions: Trusted launcher constructs Session from a validated existing Registry binding and matching Authorizer; only bound Session.context.security_domain determines shared content authority. Store.funding exists solely for shared group accounting.

Pass the existing shared content Budget to Store.create and the existing shared inflight Budget through Options.verification_budget. Do not mint independent per-request caps. Use a thread-safe allocator for concurrent calls.

Store, Registry, Authorizer, both Budgets and cancellation storage outlive every call and outstanding pin. The host stops new calls, joins every Store/Session operation (including evict/stats/invalidateWorkspace/unpin/lineIndex users), drains pins, then calls exclusive Store.deinit. Busy protects observe/get and retained pins but is not a concurrent destruction barrier.

Pin.bytes and lineIndex are borrowed immutable storage valid only while their exact owned pin remains live. Do not unpin concurrently with a borrower. Unpin deliberately works after cancellation/revocation so existing storage can drain.

cacheGet conforms exactly to frozen core.CacheGetFn(Session). Its error set cannot express Cancelled/DeadlineExceeded/version/file errors, so those fail closed to null. Callers must recheck Cancel before fallback. Prefer cacheGetChecked to preserve precise errors.

Each checked-live lookup reauthorizes and hashes the current whole rooted file before cache existence/pin. Never treat a mutable association, path, mtime or size as verified content. No managed-generation shortcut is implemented.

After a read with whole-file SHA-256, call observe with immutable complete bytes, the matching FileVersion and interactive access. bulk_scan bypasses admission. Cache bypass/refusal is an optimization outcome and the authoritative reader owns fallback semantics.

Fixed capacities default entries16/associations32/pins64/probation32; hard caps32/64/128/64. Max file size8 MiB can only be narrowed. All fixed capacity is charged even when options lower limits. PinBudget bounds cumulative per-session charged pin bytes; shared content is allocated and group-counted once per domain/hash.
limitations: Native macOS Apple Silicon/Intel, Windows and real MCP/host integration NOT_RUN. Linux x86_64 alone is runtime-proven.
This task implements cache modules and tests; root owns runtime wiring, shared build/core/contracts and task status changes.
Every checked-live cache lookup still performs a whole-file SHA-256. This conservative implementation establishes correctness and ownership, not a speedup or performance threshold.
Only valid UTF-8 without NUL and files at most8 MiB are admitted. Content and sparse index share one bounded allocation. No persistence, mmap, daemon or network dependency.
remaining_gates: Root must apply reviewed commits and run actual integration binaries.
Native macOS/Windows and real host runtime gates remain NOT_RUN.
